title: Pulse demo content pack (pulse.demopack.v1)
description: The seed pack scripts/uat/Seed-DemoContent.ps1 loads into an exercise (demo-polish implementation.md section 1.10). File paths are relative to the folder that holds pack.json. This schema covers the SHAPE. The seeder also enforces the rules a JSON Schema cannot express, before it sends anything: keys are unique, every ref resolves, a reply comes after its parent in the array and not earlier in scenario time, text is at most 280 code points (an emoji counts once), each file exists inside the pack folder, its first bytes are JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP (images) or MP4/WebM (videos) and match its kind, images are at most 5 MiB and videos at most 100 MiB, a post carries up to 4 images or exactly 1 video (never both), a burst's window holds 3 s between posts (at least 3 x (posts - 1) seconds), a run-sheet reply names an earlier post of its own item or a post of an EARLIER item (no loops), and every handle and run-sheet assignee exists in the exercise (checked after sign-in). Keys must also be unique ignoring case. Noise text follows the post-text rules (1 to 280 code points after trimming, no markup); each pin names a post key; msel values are unique ignoring case; and with -RunSheet exceptMsel no seeded run-sheet item may reply to an msel item (the on-stage MSEL import creates that one later).

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this file.

county.description: Informational: the fictional county the pack depicts.

personas.description: Profile edits for personas that ALREADY exist in the exercise (the seeder never creates personas). Absent field = unchanged; null clears bio, location, avatar or banner.

media.description: Every uploadable post attachment, by pack-local key.

posts.description: The opening feed. Posted as controller-as-persona in scenario-time order (scenarioTime = anchor - minutesBeforeAnchor); ties keep array order.

noise.description: The white-noise pool (demo-feedback DF-12): posts the server's pacer publishes as background chatter (origin noise) while a controller has the noise level above off. The seeder REPLACES the exercise's pool with these (PUT /api/staff/noise/pool) and always leaves the level off. Absent: the server's pool is left as it is.

pins.description: Keys of posts (from posts) a controller pins for everyone (PUT /api/staff/posts/{id}/pin, DF-7). They show first on every participant's Pinned tab, in this order while the exercise clock runs (with it stopped the server may order them by the posts' own scenario times).

key.description: A pack-local key: letters, digits, '_' and '-', 1 to 64 characters.

handle.description: A persona handle without '@' (e.g. FulcoEM). Matched case-insensitively against the exercise's personas.

file.description: A path relative to the pack folder (e.g. media/water.jpg). It must stay inside the pack folder.

alt.description: Alt text (NFR-001). Required, not blank, at most 1000 characters, no markup.

markup.description: Markup-like text ('<' then a letter, '/', '!' or '?'). The server strips tags, so such text would not read as written; every free-text field refuses it. '<' before a space or a digit is fine.

postText.description: At most 280 code points, no markup. The seeder counts code points; a schema validator may count differently for emoji.

baseline.description: The staff-only seeded engagement (the fictional crowd). Integers 0 to 1,000,000.

displayName.description: 1 to 100 characters, at least one visible; no control or bidirectional-override characters; no markup.

bio.description: At most 512 characters; line breaks and tabs allowed; no markup; null clears it.

location.description: At most 100 characters; no markup; null clears it.

avatar.description: An image file (uploaded, then set as avatarMediaId); null clears the avatar.

banner.description: An image file (uploaded, then set as bannerMediaId); null clears the banner.

poster.description: Videos only: an image uploaded first and passed as the video's posterMediaId.

alt.description: Overrides the media item's alt for this post.

minutesBeforeAnchor.description: scenarioTime = anchor - this many minutes. The anchor defaults to the time of the run (-ScenarioAnchor overrides it).

media.description: Up to 4 images or exactly 1 video, never both.

replyTo.description: The key of the parent post, which must appear EARLIER in this array.

injectItem.description: One run-sheet item: inject-queue 06's InjectItemWrite (POST /api/injects), with pack references where the wire has ids (persona for personaId, assignee for assigneeId, media[].ref for mediaId, replyTo naming a pack post or a run-sheet post). It lands pending at the end of the console's queue; nothing fires on its own.

key.description: Stable pack key: the seed manifest maps it to the created item id, so a re-run never duplicates.

kind.description: post: exactly 1 post. burst: 2 to 20 posts the server releases across burstWindowSeconds.

msel.description: The MSEL Inject # the on-stage Cadence MSEL import creates this item from (DF-16). Post items only; unique ignoring case. With -RunSheet exceptMsel the seeder leaves this item for the import; with all it loads it like any other.

title.description: Controller-facing, 1 to 120 code points after trimming; no markup.

notes.description: Controller-facing, at most 500 code points; no markup.

plannedMinute.description: T+N shown in the console: a display and sort hint only (no scheduler).

assignee.description: "me" (the staff user who runs the seed), or the display name of a staff member assigned to the exercise, ignoring case (GET /api/injects/assignees). Absent or null: unassigned. Assignment is a filter, not a lock.

burstWindowSeconds.description: Bursts only. Default 90. Must also be at least 3 x (posts - 1) (3 s between posts).

noiseEntry.description: One white-noise post: the persona's handle (the seeder sends its id) and its text.

text.description: 1 to 280 code points after trimming; no markup.

persona.description: The authoring persona's handle; the seeder sends its id.

text.description: 1 to 280 code points after trimming; no markup.

media.description: Pack media keys; up to 4 images or exactly 1 video, never both. Sent as { mediaId, alt }.

injectReplyTo.description: Exactly one form. { postKey }: a post of this pack's opening feed (sent as { postId }). { sequence }: an EARLIER post of this item, 1-based (sent as { sequence }). { item, sequence }: a post of an EARLIER run-sheet item (sent as { injectPostId }); naming this item's own key is the same as { sequence }.

runSheet.description: The scripted posts for the console's run sheet (inject-queue 06 + 07). After the opening feed is posted, the seeder creates each item with POST /api/injects, in this order.
